stock.description: Tycoon Group Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding enterprise, specializing in the worldwide distribution and retail of an extensive portfolio of health and wellness products. Its market presence extends across Hong Kong, Mainland China, Macau, and various international regions. The company's operations are divided into three distinct divisions: Distribution, E-Commerce, and physical Retail Stores. It offers a diverse selection of goods, including traditional Chinese medicine, nutritional supplements, skincare, personal care items, and other healthcare solutions, sold under both its proprietary labels and third-party brands. Sales channels encompass wholesale distribution to major chain retailers, independent stores, and traders, alongside direct-to-consumer sales through its own network of brick-and-mortar shops and digital platforms. Founded in 2015, the firm is based in Shatin, Hong Kong.
